verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server repository (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) under its own GitHub org, and a probe confirms it is documented there, so agents can connect to Elasticsearch through an official MCP server. The evidence is limited to the repo's existence and gives no detail on what it does or how to set it up. Missing for 10: documented tool list and capabilities, setup and transport or auth instructions, maturity or support status, independent or hands-on corroboration.
